title: Selecting Stable Sampling Dynamics for Compositional Diffusion: A Feynman-Kac Weight Reduction
abstract: arXiv:2611.29764v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Given $K$ separately trained diffusion models, how should one sample from a $\beta_k$-weighted product of their terminal laws without jointly retraining the experts? Existing Feynman--Kac constructions provide many weighted stochastic differential equations (SDEs) with the correct target marginal. The consequential question is how to select useful proposal dynamics among them. We study an explicit family of weighted diffusions that realizes the same product-of-intermediate-experts trajectory. A scalar parameter $\lambda$ controls how strongly the proposal drift follows the composed expert score, while an additional Langevin component can be varied independently. Writing $B=\sum_{k=1}^{K}\beta_k>0$, we identify the distinguished choice $\lambda=1/B$. translated_title: 面向组合扩散的稳定采样动力学选择：一种Feynman-Kac权重约简方法
translated_abstract: 给定K个分别独立训练的扩散模型，如何在不联合重新训练专家模型的情况下，从其终端分布的β_k加权乘积中进行采样？现有的Feynman-Kac构造提供了许多具有正确目标边缘分布的加权随机微分方程（SDE），随之而来的关键问题是如何从中选择有用的提议动力学。我们研究了一族显式的加权扩散过程，它们实现相同的“中间专家乘积”轨迹。标量参数λ控制提议漂移跟随组合专家分数的强度，而额外的朗之万分量可以独立变化。记B=Σ_{k=1}^{K}β_k>0，我们确定了特殊取值λ=1/B。在该取值下，瞬时Feynman-Kac对数权重速率中的聚合平方分数项恰好完全抵消。对于正的专家指数，剩余的分数分歧贡献项……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文在Feynman-Kac加权扩散框架中确定λ=1/B（B为各专家权重之和）这一特殊取值，此时瞬时对数权重中的聚合平方分数项恰好完全抵消，从而为组合扩散采样选出最稳定的提议动力学。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the distinguished choice λ=1/B (where B is the sum of expert weights) among Feynman-Kac weighted diffusion dynamics, at which the aggregate squared-score term in the instantaneous log-weight rate cancels exactly, yielding the most stable proposal dynamics for compositional diffusion sampling.
